Notices for third-party code embedded in the FreeType 2.14.3 checkout
=====================================================================

Tilefinch links FreeType under the FreeType License (FTL.TXT in this
directory).  The FreeType sources additionally embed two bodies of
third-party code whose notices must accompany binary distributions.

Required FTL credit:

  Portions of this software are copyright (c) The FreeType Project
  (www.freetype.org).  All rights reserved.
